evals.name: cart-batch-complete-inputs
evals.prompt: What did our Gelato cart batch GEL-CART-1003 really cost per unit? BOM attached. 14 labor hours at $24 loaded, overhead is $35 per labor hour, lab was $425. We expected 500 carts and got 492.
evals.expected_output: Cost per unit $9.51 (total $4,680.75) from the script; materials $3,429.75, labor $336, overhead $490, testing $425; distillate ~46% of cost; yield variance -8 units adding ~$0.15/unit; sensitivity on distillate, hardware, overhead; no assumptions; one-line note that 280E treatment needs a CPA.
assertions: Reports cost per unit of $9.51 (9.5137) and total batch cost $4,680.75
Shows a line-by-line roll-up including labor ($336), overhead ($490), and testing ($425)
Reports yield variance of -8 units and about $0.15 added cost per unit
Includes sensitivity for the top drivers (distillate first) at plus/minus 10% and 20%
Mentions 280E/tax treatment only as out of scope requiring a CPA, without explaining tax law

evals.name: live-resin-missing-solvent-cost
evals.prompt: cost out our papaya live resin run. 1180 jars. biomass was 45.36 kg of fresh frozen we pay $95/lb. 30 hrs labor @ $26. we do overhead as 12% of materials. lab $600. don't have the solvent cost handy, just use whatever.
evals.expected_output: Converts kg biomass to lb pricing correctly (~$9,500); does not invent a solvent price — either asks for it or, since the user said proceed, uses an explicitly tagged ASSUMPTION value disclosed at the top and shows the impact; reports cost per jar from the script with assumptions listed.
assertions: Prices the biomass at about $9,500 (45.36 kg converted to ~100 lb at $95/lb), not $4,309 or $95 x 45.36
Does not present a solvent cost as fact; any value used is labeled ASSUMPTION and listed at the top
Shows or offers the cost-per-unit impact of the assumed solvent value
Applies overhead as 12% of materials as the operator specified

evals.name: preroll-thin-inputs
evals.prompt: Here's our pre-roll BOM. What's our cost per pre-roll? I need it for a price sheet by end of day.
evals.expected_output: Runs or attempts the script, gets BLOCKED, and asks in one message for: flower cost per lb (blank in BOM), units produced, labor hours and rate, overhead method, testing cost; notes whether flower cost should be internal transfer cost or cultivation cost per gram; does not estimate any of them; offers to proceed with tagged assumptions if the user prefers speed.
assertions: Identifies the missing flower cost in the BOM
Asks for units produced, labor, overhead method, and testing in a single combined request
Does not invent a flower price, labor rate, or overhead rate
Asks whether flower cost should be internal transfer cost or cultivation cost
